_what: How tool:read-a-camera-card-index reads a camera card's own index and groups its clips into recording sessions. Every name the camera writes and every time it takes is here, not in code. Reading only: the reader never writes, copies, moves or deletes anything on the card.
why_since: A card holds its whole history (164 clips here, October to November 20). Only clips recorded at or after this time are seeded on a first arrival; a later edit to this row widens or narrows it. The seed id makes a repeat read a no-op, so a card read again adds only its new sessions.
